selfHelpStops.condition: The prosecutor or a victim files an objection.
Whether a dismissal was with or without prejudice cannot be determined.
Immigration, licensing or firearm consequences are in play.

requiredParticipantInputQuestions.question: How did the matter end — dismissed with prejudice, no billed, found not guilty, nolle prossed, or indictment quashed?
Was the dismissal with prejudice or without prejudice?
On what date did the matter end? More than 90 days must have passed.
In which county were the charges filed?
Have you paid everything the court ordered in the case?

supportingDocuments.obtainedFrom: The clerk of the court where the charges were filed
supportingDocuments.howToObtain: Ask the clerk for a certified copy of the arrest record, disposition, or case action summary.

supportingDocuments.name: Certified ALEA criminal record
supportingDocuments.howToObtain: Request a certified criminal record from ALEA.
